notes.title: Diamond Caves - the Level Editor finally arrived
notes.content:
A new update to Diamond Caves is available:
Version 5.0.4

 the Level Editor is available
 added in-game option to turn on vsync


I will post a Steam Guide for the Level Editor within the next days, I am sure there are a few questions on how to do certain things. To start the Editor, right click on the game in Steam and select "Start Game Editor".

You can use the Editor to create your own levels, download new levels from the Steam Workshop or import old Diamond Caves 3 Levelgroups.

If you have problems with game stuttering please try combinations of game speed and vsync.

notes.title: Diamond Caves - first update
notes.content:
Here ist the first minor update to Diamond Caves, it will fix a few bugs:
Version 5.0.2

 in some cases, the scores of completed bonus levels were not counted towards the collection highscore - fixed
 team advanced level 36 was missing an exit for the second player - fixed
 it was possible to ignite multiple sticks of dynamite at the same time - fixed
 updated tube graphics to better show the way for the player
 added more checks for system requirements in case Diamond Caves does not start


Still to come is the new levelgroup "Emerald Caves" which will be released within the next days.

notes.title: Diamond Caves is here! What now?
notes.content:
Diamond Caves has finally arrived at Steam, I hope you are enjoying the Levels and new features of the game.

What's next?


Within the coming week there will be an update delivering bugfixes and a few missing features (like customizable controls).

A new Levelgroup with 50 additional single player Levels is almost finished and will hit all eager Players in early December.

An important part of Diamond Caves has always been the Level Editor. Wether you just want to take a look at all the Levels you already played - or maybe you want to create a complete collection of Levels all by yourself? The new Level Editor integrates into the Steam Workshop mechanism, meaning that it will now be easier than ever to share your creations with other users.
 

As a small appetizer, here is a screenshot of the work-in-progress Level Editor:
